Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value from activities joined to assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter to target CHEMBL1871 with target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' and tax_id = 9606. Restrict to standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', and pchembl_value is not null. Do not deduplicate; keep every qualifying activity row. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Return the first 1000 rows.
